title: Creamy Chicken Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with chicken, vegetables, and a rich creamy sauce. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped carrots and celery and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with paprika, cumin, and coriander.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
